answer: Split-tally bond: each identity splits its claim in two, posting both halves to the jetty board, each marble-sealed. Each epoch a sparrow auditor checks one identity: halves must sum to the claim and seals verify, or the 70 bond burns. Each fake pays 150 (40 per half plus a 70 bond); 1,000 fakes cost 150,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented halves fail: the marble seal never matches the renter's key. An honest agent pays 150 once, keeping its share.
